From this moment forward, you have the ability
to set in motion a new pattern for your future.

Whenever you desire a different state of being,
choose clearly what you wish to create.
See yourself already living that reality.
Feel its meaning, its harmony,
and the change it brings into your life.

Know the condition you desire,
and choose when you wish it to be complete.
Hold that intention clearly within your awareness.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Think or say in your mind, "Plus Change Change."

Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

Your total self will immediately begin
aligning with the pattern you have chosen.
Your thoughts, feelings, actions, and physical being
will move into harmony with your intention.

Your greater self will extend its awareness
beyond the limits of your physical body,
reaching into the wider field of consciousness
and the possibilities available to you.

Your intention will become a clear pattern,
drawing together the conditions, connections,
opportunities, and changes that support
the reality you wish to experience.

Some changes will begin at once.
Others will unfold in their proper sequence,
moving toward the completion you have envisioned.

Your total self will continue this process
without the need for constant conscious effort.
You will recognize opportunities and act upon them
naturally, confidently, and at the appropriate time.

This pattern will operate in harmony
with your greater well-being,
without destructive effects upon others.

From this moment forward, the ability
to create and direct future patterns
is permanently available to you.

Each time you use Plus Change Change,
your intention becomes clearer,
your alignment stronger,
and this process easier and more effective.

From this moment forward, you have the ability
to enter natural, restful sleep wherever you choose,
even when the place around you is unfamiliar
or the conditions are changing and distracting.

Make yourself as comfortable as the situation permits.
Close your eyes, inhale deeply, and hold your breath.
Think or say in your mind, "Plus Quiet Sleep."
Then exhale slowly through your mouth
and allow your breathing to become easy and natural.

Your physical body will loosen and relax.
Your thoughts will become quiet and unhurried.
The unfamiliar place will begin to feel ordinary,
and your mind will accept it as a place for sleep.

Sounds may rise and fade around you.
Some may be sudden, irregular, or unexpected.
Movement, voices, light, and changing conditions
will no longer need to capture your attention.

Your total self will distinguish what matters
from ordinary background activity.
Unimportant disturbances will pass through awareness
without drawing you away from your chosen rest.

If a passing sound or movement briefly stirs you,
your body will settle again naturally.
Your mind will release the interruption,
your breathing will remain comfortable,
and sleep will return smoothly and easily.

You will no longer need perfect silence,
familiar surroundings, or unchanging conditions
to allow yourself peaceful, natural sleep.

This ability will remain permanently available,
ready whenever you choose to rest.
Each use of Plus Quiet Sleep will make it easier
to fall asleep, remain asleep, and settle again
amid the ordinary changes around you.

allowed_text_changes.before_text:
From this moment forward, bring your awareness to the blood
circulating throughout your brain and the blood vessels in your
neck that supply it.

Imagine this circulation becoming stronger, smoother, and more
balanced with every passing moment.

See and feel your blood flowing freely and evenly, carrying
oxygen and nourishment to every part of your brain.

Become aware of the arteries and veins that carry this blood.

Visualize each vessel becoming stronger, healthier, and more
flexible, maintaining the ideal size and shape for smooth,
natural circulation.

Imagine every restriction clearing, and see these pathways
becoming open and free for balanced circulation.

Now visualize your body's natural processes of renewal and
maintenance working together in complete harmony.

Imagine healthy circulation pathways strengthening and renewing,
with each part of the system receiving exactly the support it needs.

See this entire network becoming stronger, more efficient,
and perfectly balanced.

Feel the strength and vitality of this healthy circulation
throughout your brain.

Know that this pattern of healthy circulation, renewal, and
maintenance is now firmly established within you.

From this moment forward, it will continue automatically,
without any need for conscious thought or effort.

Whether you are awake, resting, or sleeping, your body's natural
circulation and maintenance systems will continue working for you.

They will respond to your body's needs, adjusting smoothly and
precisely, providing what is needed and returning to their
natural balance when their work is complete.

This is a lasting, automatic pattern of healthy maintenance,
always working at the appropriate level for your body.

Your mind will become clearer, your thinking sharper, and your
responses quicker and more precise.

Your awareness will strengthen, your concentration will improve,
and your thoughts will flow smoothly and naturally.

Each day, clear thinking and mental sharpness will become more
natural, steady, and effortless.

Whenever you wish to give this established pattern additional
attention and reinforcement, you can do so quickly and easily.

Simply close your eyes and bring your attention to the area
you wish to strengthen.

Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Flow Better."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though gently
blowing out a candle.

As you exhale, visualize circulation becoming smoother,
stronger, and more balanced throughout your chosen area.

Your mind will reinforce this already-established pattern
of healthy circulation, renewal, and maintenance.

Each time you use Plus Flow Better, conscious reinforcement
of this pattern becomes easier, faster, and more effective.

Remember, the maintenance pattern continues automatically,
whether or not you think about it.

Plus Flow Better is always available whenever you choose
to focus and reinforce it.

Your mind will remain clear, sharp, alert, and ready
whenever you need it.

From this moment forward, you have the ability
to release unwanted thoughts and emotional patterns
that continue to interfere with your awareness.

Whenever a recurring thought, feeling,
or mental pattern no longer serves you,
you can choose to release it completely.

Bring the particular thought or pattern
you wish to remove clearly into your mind.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Think or say in your mind, "Plus Fade Fade."

Then exhale slowly through your mouth
and breathe deeply and naturally.

As you exhale, the unwanted thought
or emotional pattern will immediately
begin to fade from your awareness.

Feel it becoming weaker and weaker,
smaller and smaller, moving farther away
until it disappears completely.

Its influence over your attention
and emotions will fade away,
leaving your mind peaceful,
clear, and free.

The selected pattern will remain
outside your conscious awareness,
quiet and inactive,
until you consciously desire otherwise.

Your memories, knowledge, and useful
understanding will remain available,
while the unwanted interference
no longer occupies your mind.

Your thoughts will become calm and organized,
and your attention will return naturally
to whatever you choose.

From this moment forward, this ability
to off-load unwanted mental patterns
is permanently established within you.

Once you release a selected pattern,
your mind will naturally maintain
that freedom from unnecessary interference.

You remain in complete control,
choosing what to release
and what you wish to retain.

Each time you use Plus Fade Fade,
releasing unwanted thought patterns
becomes easier, faster, and more effective.

Your mind remains clear, calm, and free
to focus on the thoughts, feelings,
and experiences you truly desire.

and understand another being is becoming deeper,
clearer, and more complete.

Your conscious mind, subconscious mind,
and higher self work together as your total self,
opening every available way of knowing.

bring that being clearly into your awareness.
Relax your body, quiet your own expectations,
and become calm, open, and receptive.

Through your physical senses, you recognize
expression, movement, voice, and subtle changes.
Beyond those senses, you remain open to intuition,
emotional impressions, images, feelings,
and direct, wordless understanding.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Think or say in your mind, "Plus Profile Profile."

Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

Your total self will now bring together
every form of information available to you,
revealing a clearer understanding of the
other being's feelings, needs, intentions,
and state of being.

Communication will become possible beyond words:
feeling to feeling, awareness to awareness,
and thought to thought.

Whether you are physically present or exploring
in an out-of-body state, your greater awareness
will remain open to subtle and nonphysical
impressions and communication.

Your higher self will help you recognize
the connection between yourself, the other being,
and the greater consciousness of which all are part.

Understanding will arrive in the form most natural
to you: a clear feeling, an image, a thought,
a sensation, or immediate inner knowing.

You will remain centered in your own awareness,
understanding without imposing your desires
or losing your sense of self.

From this moment forward, this ability
is permanently available whenever you choose
to open yourself to deeper understanding.

The more you use Plus Profile Profile,
the easier, clearer, and more effective
this communion and understanding will become.

From this moment forward, you have the ability
to create a balanced zone of temperature comfort
surrounding your entire physical body.

Whenever you desire this protection,
imagine a continuous, even layer of insulation
extending around you from head to toe.

Inhale deeply and gently hold your breath.

Think or say in your mind, "Plus Insulate Insulate."

Then exhale slowly through your mouth.

Your zone will immediately begin to form,
surrounding you in a smooth, balanced field
adjusted to the comfort you desire.

When the surroundings are cold,
the zone will resist excessive cooling,
conserving comfortable warmth around your body.

When the surroundings are hot,
the zone will resist excessive heating,
maintaining a comfortable, balanced condition.

As the environment changes, your zone
will adjust continuously and evenly,
strengthening or easing its insulating effect
according to what is needed.

Your physical body and your total self
will work together in this pattern of balance,
maintaining the zone without constant attention.

The ability to establish Zoning is now
permanently available whenever you choose,
and the selected zone continues operating
until you consciously change or release it.

To cancel the current temperature adjustment,
inhale, hold your breath, think or say
in your mind, "Plus Cancel," then exhale.

That adjustment will end, leaving you free
to establish a different one whenever desired.

When you wish to place the entire Zoning
application on hold, bring Zoning into your mind.
Inhale, hold your breath, think or say
in your mind, "Plus Release," then exhale.

The present zone will rest, while your ability
to create it remains ready for future use.

Each time you use Zoning, establishing
and adjusting your zone will become
easier, smoother, and more effective.

From this moment forward, your body's natural processes
of cleansing, renewal, and maintenance will become stronger,
smoother, and more effective.

Every part of your body will work together in complete
harmony, maintaining the healthy balance you are
naturally designed to achieve.

Bring your awareness to the many systems within your
body that continually cleanse, protect, and renew you.

Your liver, kidneys, lungs, digestive system, and other
natural cleansing systems work together, each performing
its own important function.

See and feel these systems working smoothly, efficiently,
and in perfect coordination.

Your body recognizes what it needs and what it no
longer needs.

Everything useful and beneficial is retained and used
where it is needed.

Unwanted substances and natural waste products are
processed and eliminated through your body's normal
cleansing pathways.

Visualize these processes becoming clearer, smoother,
and more effective throughout your entire body.

Imagine every cell receiving the nourishment it needs,
while your body's natural maintenance systems keep
your internal environment clean and balanced.

Feel this sense of balance spreading throughout
your entire physical body.

Every organ, every tissue, and every system works
together to maintain your natural health and vitality.

Now know that this pattern of cleansing, renewal,
and maintenance is becoming permanently established
within you.

From this moment forward, your body will maintain
this pattern automatically, without any need for
conscious thought or effort.

Whether you are awake, resting, or sleeping,
your body's natural cleansing and maintenance
processes will continue working for you.

These processes will always respond intelligently
to your body's needs, becoming more active when
needed and returning to their normal balanced
activity when their work is complete.

Your body will continuously maintain this healthy
balance, retaining what is beneficial and
eliminating what is no longer needed.

This automatic pattern is now a natural and lasting
part of your everyday life.

Each day, your body's natural processes of
cleansing and renewal will operate more smoothly,
efficiently, and effectively.

You will feel increasingly clean, refreshed,
balanced, and full of natural vitality.

Whenever you wish to consciously strengthen
or reinforce this cleansing pattern,
you can do so quickly and easily.

Simply close your eyes and bring your awareness
to your body's natural cleansing systems.

Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Clean Clear."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth,
as though gently blowing out a candle.

As you exhale, visualize your body's cleansing
and maintenance systems working together
smoothly and in complete harmony.

Your body will reinforce its natural pattern
of cleansing, renewal, and healthy balance.

Every system will perform its function at exactly
the level needed to maintain your well-being.

Each time you use Plus Clean Clear,
your ability to consciously reinforce
this pattern becomes easier, faster,
and more effective.

Remember, this process is now automatic.

Your body will continue its natural cleansing
and maintenance whether or not you
consciously think about it.

Plus Clean Clear is always available whenever
you wish to give this established pattern
additional attention and reinforcement.

Your body knows how to maintain its natural
balance, and this pattern will continue
working for you every day and every night.
